references.text: Elisur, son of Shedeur, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Reuben during the census, demonstrating the tribe's leadership in various contexts.
Moses gave new names to some of the spies, including Hoshea who was called Joshua, highlighting the significance of the names given to those sent out.
Reuben was Jacob's firstborn son with Leah, and here his descendants are mentioned as one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
The sons of Reuben are listed, showing the lineage of Reuben's tribe to which Shammua belonged.
